page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture and is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, which translates to a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. There is no bundled local storage or GPU hardware on this instance, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. This high-throughput network interface, combined with the large vCPU count and balanced memory capacity, makes it suitable for enterprise-grade applications, large-scale web serving, database hosting, and distributed computing tasks that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
